modules.name: lid_rib
modules.doc: Ribs stop short of the top/bottom chamfers so they don't poke through the sloped edges, and stop a further rib thickness short of that so their flat ends stay tucked inside the rounded rings instead of poking past them.

modules.name: lid_rib_ring
modules.doc: Encircling band matching the rib's radial and vertical thickness, flush with the top/bottom of the ribbed section.

modules.name: spiral_path
modules.doc: Archimedean spiral centerline, starting in the wall of the inner ring

modules.name: outer_ring_center
modules.doc: Centre of the outer ring, continuing along the band's end tangent

modules.name: wave_corners
modules.doc: Trapezoid wave corners: the flat projection of a helix with flat crests

modules.name: ring_attach_x
modules.doc: X distance from a ring's center to where a band at height y meets its mid-radius

modules.name: band_region
modules.doc: A single band at height y between the rings, bulging towards +Y

modules.name: leaf_pair_regions
modules.doc: Two parallel leaves bowing towards +Y

modules.name: leg_path
modules.doc: Right leg, leaving the loop end

modules.name: hook_path
modules.doc: Right end coil: a bend toward the axis, a straight diagonal, then a counterclockwise coil (opposite to the big loop)

modules.name: handle_path
modules.doc: Right handle stub, leaving the coil end outward into the bar

modules.name: bar_outline
modules.doc: Grip bar leaning away from the middle axis

modules.name: omega_path
modules.doc: Omega centerline from the left handle over the loop to the right handle

modules.name: handle_outline
modules.doc: Stub and bar merged, with concave corners filled out into a flared root

modules.name: spring_outline
modules.doc: Outline of the loop, hooks, stubs and bars, merged so the chamfer runs uninterrupted

modules.name: wave_corners
modules.doc: Trapezoid wave corners: the flat projection of a helix with flat crests Handles overlap the ring walls by epsilon to fuse with them

modules.name: joints
modules.doc: Full-height blocks that bridge the ring chamfers at both spring ends; their faces inside the ring walls stay unchamfered

modules.name: dovetail_flanged_wall_path
modules.doc: Generates an open 2D path with the dovetail shape

modules.name: body_2d
modules.doc: Body outline: hub, top edge, right edge, rounded corner, and a lower edge running at slope_angle up to the top of the socket circle.

modules.name: link
modules.doc: Link lying in the XY plane, hub axis at the origin, +X towards the socket

modules.name: diamond_groove
modules.doc: V-shaped notch: wide at the surface, tapering to a point at groove_depth.

modules.name: diamond_grooves_trimmed
modules.doc: Confine the crossed grooves to the mid-section so the top and bottom rims stay solid, giving clean, ungrooved ends.

modules.name: ripple_angle
modules.doc: A softly wandering centerline for one recessed ripple.

modules.name: ripple_cutter
modules.doc: Hulling neighboring spheres makes a continuous, rounded groove cutter.

modules.name: rib_ring
modules.doc: Encircling band matching the rib's radial and vertical thickness.

modules.name: rib_profile
modules.doc: Hulled ellipses keep each rib smooth while its centerline follows the wave.

modules.name: f
modules.doc: Outer function: defines the outer curve in the region as a function of y

modules.name: g
modules.doc: Inner function: defines the inner curve in the region as a function of y Set g(y) = 0 to automatically switch to disk method (no hole)

modules.name: washer
modules.doc: Washer Module: creates a washer at a given z position

modules.name: sample_z
modules.doc: Sample point selection based on sampling method

modules.name: stadium_plate
modules.doc: Two discs joined by hull() make a stadium-shaped plate

modules.name: adapter_shape
modules.doc: A thin square slice at the bottom and a thin disc at the top; the hull blends between them, so a smaller copy subtracted gives a hollow adapter

modules.name: bracket
modules.doc: Base plate hulled with an offset post: the hull creates the smooth sloped flank without manual polyhedron work

modules.name: ibeam

modules.name: strip_angle
modules.doc: Strips are evenly spread over 180 degrees

modules.name: strip_halfwidth
modules.doc: Strip half-width on layer k

modules.name: bridge
modules.doc: Bridge k: the part of the hexagon outside the polygon of layer k. It starts at its own layer and is extruded up to the top of the stack, so later bridges never span gaps left by earlier ones.

modules.name: bridge_opening
modules.doc: Opening of layer k: all strips of that layer intersected

modules.name: nut_cavity
modules.doc: The hexagonal pocket and the room above it, minus all the bridges

modules.name: screw_hole
modules.doc: Vertical shank hole from the top face down to two nut thicknesses below the nut slot

modules.name: nut_slot
modules.doc: Horizontal hex nut pocket at the screw tip that opens onto the +X side
